key_insight: A temporal-difference flow extends neural tangent kernel analysis to RL with time-varying mini-batches and targets, yielding a closed-form description of value-function evolution in an overparameterized setting.
engineering_relevance: The formulation enables optimization-based exploration that incorporates environment constraints and can improve sample efficiency.
method: Formulate NTK-based temporal-difference dynamics with changing mini-batches and targets.
Derive a closed-form solution for value-function evolution.
Use the solution and environment constraints to guide state-space exploration.
evidence_signal: Experiments in a deterministic grid environment demonstrate adaptation to training-distribution shifts and improved sample efficiency from the exploration strategy.
watch_item: Validation is limited to a deterministic grid environment; applicability to finite-width networks and more complex or stochastic environments remains uncertain.
paper_title: Bridging Neural Tangent Kernel Analysis and Reinforcement Learning for Deep Function Approximation
